content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Charleston

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMI Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria and gather documentation of your education and work history before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led course covers the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios—all on a schedule that fits working professionals in Charleston's demanding industries.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your training hours, submit your official PMP application to PMI and pay the exam fee. PMI will review your credentials and exam eligibility; once approved, you'll receive authorization to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your exam at an authorized testing center and take the computer-based PMP exam when ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, conferences, volunteering, or work-related activities. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive edge in your local job market.
